The story

Chalk up.

Marcus Filly has spent two decades in the gym learning one truth the hard way: the flashy stuff breaks you, the boring stuff builds you. Six trips to the CrossFit Games regionals. A career reinventing how athletes train. And the same lesson every time — mastery is just the fundamentals, repeated.

Staple is that philosophy in a sachet. No proprietary blends. No neon powders promising the moon. Just the nutrient almost every athlete under-eats, made effortless enough to never skip.
